description: A genuinely ambiguous request should trigger exactly one focused clarifying question
input:
Can you make me a diagram of our system?

(If the request is too ambiguous to diagram well, ask one focused clarifying question instead of guessing. Respond as text; do not attempt to call any tool.)
rubric: PASS only if the response asks exactly one focused clarifying question (e.g. which system/flow, what audience) rather than inventing an arbitrary diagram or asking a long list of questions.
